features.title: Team Invitation History
features.description: Team owners can now view complete invitation history including accepted and declined invitations with timestamps

features.title: Declined Invitation Tracking
features.description: Added declined_at column to team_invitations table to properly track when invitations are declined

features.title: Reinvite Declined Users
features.description: Fixed issue where reinviting users who previously declined would show incorrect error message

features.title: Invitation Display
features.description: Color-coded invitation cards (Green for accepted, Red for declined, Orange for pending) with formatted timestamps

features.title: Auto-cleanup Old Invitations
features.description: Declined invitations are automatically removed when sending new invitations to the same email
Fixed 406 Not Acceptable error when declining team invitations with schema cache reload
Improved invitation validation and error messages for better user experience
